purpose: Localize the Bell discrepancy within the SpinQ-specific execution path

tests.name: xx
tests.interpretation: Failure occurs without CNOT or superposition; this is not ordinary 1000-shot sampling noise.

tests.name: xcx-forward
tests.interpretation: The forward CNOT direction drives the expected state but has substantial error.

tests.name: xcx-reverse
tests.interpretation: The reverse CNOT direction also drives the expected state; operand reversal is not the Bell root cause.

conclusion: The submitted QASM gate names and CNOT operand directions are functioning. The anomaly is already present in the X-only baseline, localizing the discrepancy after LoomQ emission to SpinQ Cloud compilation/scheduling, NMR state preparation, calibration, measurement, or result reconstruction.
limitations: The cloud API does not expose the compiled native circuit, pulse schedule, qubit mapping, calibration record, or raw readout, so these SpinQ-internal causes cannot be separated with the available interface.
